utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard bits and pieces—what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: It’s staying low-key for now, and I’ll let folks know you can help a little with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Cleo—that’d really help us get organized for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great—can you check what supplies we still need and who can drop them off?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what details do we have so far?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Faye. Keep it low-key, and I can help a little with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So you’re definitely able to help with the repair drive, right?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yes — I can help with the repair drive. What still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: No worries, Dane — we still need a few volunteers to sort donations and help with setup. If you can lend a hand, I’ll put you on the list.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Rosa — I can help sort donations and set up. Put me on the list.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I haven’t tracked it yet, but I can keep an eye on where the repair drive is set up.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Opal — that’d be really helpful. I’ll keep spreading the word, and if you spot it, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Bo, what still needs fixing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can check what repair supplies we already have and what we still need for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ve just heard it’s still moving along, but details are a bit thin. If you want, I can check in and see what’s changed.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes, please do—I can help with the repair drive too. What still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely — I can lend a hand and a few tools for the repair drive. Just let me know what you need.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’s fantastic, Gus — thank you! I’ll let everyone know you’re pitching in and get the details to you right away.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I should check my list again, but I think a few small things still need fixing. I’ll send you the details soon.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Bo — send me the list when you can, and I’ll help sort the details.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’ll keep an eye on where the repair drive is set up and let you know if I spot it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks — if you see it, just let me know where to head.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yeah, it’s picking up nicely—folks have been dropping off tools and spare parts all morning.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’s great to hear — I’m glad people are pitching in. If you want, I can help sort the donations or keep an eye out for anything we’re still missing.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
